single.rationale: Waystar demonstrates compelling fundamentals with 16% revenue CAGR, strong margin expansion (operating margin improved from 13% to 23%), impressive free cash flow generation (26% FCF margin), and a 112% net revenue retention rate. The AI-powered platform serving 60% of US patients has powerful network effects and the company successfully turned profitable while maintaining rapid growth, though elevated P/E (45x) and significant debt warrant careful evaluation.
